text.en: Clients describe lead trainer Stephen as knowledgeable, humorous, and clear in explaining how canine body language works in dense city environments. Reviewers appreciate his patient answers to owner questions, though the business actively disputes unverified negative feedback left without client records.

title.en: Reliable leash control and place commands

text.en: Dog owners report rapid turnarounds with leash pulling, over-arousal, and recall challenges through clear command conditioning. Multiple clients highlight mastering the 'place' command, allowing high-drive hunting breeds and reactive pets to relax calmly on outdoor cafe patios.

title.en: Outdoor practice sessions in Central Park

text.en: Reviewers value conducting practical training drills amidst real-world park distractions, helping dogs overcome reactivity around other pets and wildlife. Training drills help high-energy puppies and large breeds burn mental energy while strengthening impulse control around triggers.

q.en: Where do training sessions take place?

a.en: Many hands-on sessions and group classes take place outdoors in Central Park to practice amidst real-world distractions.

q.en: Do they teach off-leash recall and e-collar conditioning?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently work on reliable off-leash recall and proper e-collar conditioning for high-drive dogs.

q.en: Can the training help with leash pulling and cafe manners?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report rapid progress mastering loose-leash walking and the 'place' command for relaxed visits to cafe patios.
